copy.intro: You know the Charlotte Russe deal: a bodycon mini for Friday at about $10, and almost nothing on the dress rail over $20. The trouble is that sold-out pieces rarely come back, and sizes stop at XL. So here are the stores people shop instead. The fast-fashion sites and mall chains selling the same cheap going-out dresses come first, then a couple of everyday stores with a dress section worth a look.

bodies.forever-21:
Forever 21 is the closest match to Charlotte Russe's mix of cheap, trend-led pieces. Its full-price dresses sit just above, like the Satin Cowl Neck Maxi Dress ($24.99).

The catch is that full price is rare here. Most of its dresses carry a markdown, some down to $14.98, so the sale section is the place to start. Sizes run XS to XXL with a separate plus section, which covers more people than Charlotte Russe's XS to XL.

It's online only now that its US stores have closed, so there's no trying things on. Shipping is free over $50, half Charlotte Russe's $100 bar. But returns cost $9.99, and clearance can't go back at all.
bodies.missguided:
Missguided is the pick for going-out dresses in the bodycon-mini mold Charlotte Russe also sells, like its Lace Bodycon Mini Dress With Corset Detail ($28.13 before markdown).

It works more like a small marketplace these days. Missguided's own dresses sit in the same listings as other labels, so check the name at the start of each title if you want the house brand. And most of what's shown is marked down, so the full price tells you less than usual.

US standard shipping is free over $67.49 and $4.49 below that, a lower bar than Charlotte Russe's. You get 30 days from delivery to start a return, though you pay the postage, and bodysuits and swimwear can't go back.
bodies.boohoo:
Boohoo is where to go if Charlotte Russe's XS to XL leaves you out. Its size guide runs from US 0 to 26, with petite, plus and tall ranges on top.

It's a Manchester store, and US orders come with no extra tariff charges. Standard US shipping is $10.99 and takes six to eight business days, so it's not the place for a dress you need by Saturday. The banners advertise up to 70% off, and the site itself says discounts may not be based on former prices, so judge the price you pay rather than the percentage.

Returns are the weak spot: 21 days, with $14.99 taken off each refund. PrettyLittleThing, further down, belongs to the same group and runs on the same terms.
bodies.windsor:
Windsor is the one for event dresses, and its prices start right where Charlotte Russe's do. The Velvet Rope Sequin Lace Up Bodycon Mini Dress is $14.

It has focused on special-occasion dresses since 1957, so the range goes much further. Homecoming, prom and formal gowns up to $199.90 sit next to the minis, and most of it still costs under $100. With more than 350 stores across the US and Canada, there's a good chance you can try a dress on before the big night.

Sizes stop at XL (a US 15), the same ceiling as Charlotte Russe. If you need bigger, Boohoo or AMIClubwear go further. US shipping is free over $75.
bodies.rue21:
Rue21 is Charlotte Russe's sister store. YM Inc., the Toronto company that owns Charlotte Russe, bought it in 2024 and reopened it, and its listings carry Stitches, the label on most of Charlotte Russe's clothes. A Striped Ribbed Off Shoulder Maxi Dress is listed at $16, right in Charlotte Russe's range.

The difference is that you shop it in person. Its website is a lookbook and a store finder covering about 120 US stores, with the most in Georgia and Texas. It sells men's casual clothes as well, which helps if you're shopping for two.

Check the policy before you buy. Unworn items can be exchanged within 14 days for another piece or a gift card, and there are no refunds.
bodies.prettylittlething:
PrettyLittleThing pitches itself at the IT girl, and it's the one to pick for a trend dress in a petite, tall or maternity cut. Sizes run from US 00 to 24 across those ranges, with plus going from 12 to 24.

It's a Manchester label from the Boohoo group, so the terms mirror Boohoo's. US shipping is a flat $9.99, and you get 21 days to send things back, with $14.99 taken off every refund. If you're likely to order again, the store credit option adds 10% to what you get back.

Like Boohoo, its banners push up to 70% off while noting that discounts may not be based on former prices, so compare the price itself. And if you'd rather try things on before you pay, Windsor and rue21 have stores.
bodies.american-eagle:
American Eagle makes sense if your Charlotte Russe trips were as much about jeans as dresses. Denim is its headline product, and several of its cuts come in Curvy versions.

Its dresses cost more at full price, but they rarely sit at full price. Nearly every dress shown carries a markdown of around 31%, from was-prices like $64.95, so watch the sale price rather than the tag. The one full-price dress shown, the AE77 Crinkle Lace Slip Cami Dress ($148), is a long way from Charlotte Russe money.

Where it beats most of this list is returns: 60 days for a full refund, with $5 off for online returns. Shipping is free over $75.
bodies.modcloth:
ModCloth is the one for retro and vintage-style dresses, and the step up from Charlotte Russe is real. Full-price dresses start at $49, where you'll find the Circe Striped Mini Dress.

What you get for that is range. Sizes go up to 4X. The store also mixes outside labels like Dangerfield and Orchid Bloom with its own collaborations, such as the GUNNE SAX for ModCloth Beth Lace Corselette Maxi Dress ($329). The marked-down dresses go far lower, but those are final sale, so pick carefully.

Shipping is free only over $150, and returns cost $14. If you want plus-size party dresses for less, AMIClubwear goes to 3X, and its dresses start at $11.50.
bodies.amiclubwear:
AMIClubwear is the most party-focused store here, with clubwear dresses from $11.50 for the Cami Heavy Rib Mini Dress, a hair above Charlotte Russe's cheapest.

It's an LA shop that buys from labels like Flying Tomato and KandyKouture. So the range runs from cheap bodycon minis to midis like the MABLE Sweetheart Neckline Floral Printed Midi Dress ($125.99). Part of the range goes up to 3X, a size Charlotte Russe doesn't stock. Standard shipping to the lower 48 is free with the code FREESHIP.

Returns are the trade-off. You get 30 days, but only for store credit, and you pay to send things back. For a cash refund, American Eagle's 60 days is the safer bet.
bodies.lucy-in-the-sky:
Lucy in the Sky is where to go when you'd rather spend more on one dress for a big night. It designs its own party dresses in Los Angeles, and full-price minis start at $55.90, like the Ruched Fit and Flare Dress in Red.

The shop is organized by occasion, from homecoming and sorority rush to New Year's Eve, so it's quick to find something for a set date. If the date is close, look for styles tagged Ships in 24 Hours. Its own advice is to size up if you're between sizes, since a small is about a US 2.

Returns are store credit only, within 14 days, so buy the one you're sure of. Windsor covers the same events with stores to try things on.
bodies.justfab:
JustFab is a shoe-first store that also sells dresses, so it's the one for getting the dress and the heels in one order.

Know how it works before you join. The big discounts are for VIP members, and membership costs $49.95 a month unless you skip between the 1st and the 5th. You don't have to join to shop, and non-members actually get free shipping sooner, at $49 instead of $70. Returns run for 60 days from shipping, among the longest windows here, and it ships to Canada too, for $9.95.

If a monthly charge sounds like one more thing to manage, Forever 21 and Missguided sell the same kind of dress with no membership at all.
bodies.uniqlo:
Uniqlo is the stop for plain, everyday dresses instead of going-out ones, like the Knitted Polo Dress ($59.90).

That's three to six times a Charlotte Russe dress at full price. It's a Japanese chain owned by Fast Retailing, which also runs GU, and sizes run XXS to XL. A good share of its dresses are marked down to $19.90 to $39.90, which brings it much closer, so check the sale first. With 86 stores in the US, you can usually try before you buy, and shipping is free over $99 or with in-store pickup. Returns run 30 days.

For cheap basics nearer Charlotte Russe's prices, Target is the better stop.
bodies.target:
Target is the everyday fallback, and Wild Fable is the line to start with. It does the halter and mini shapes Charlotte Russe sells, like the Flocked Dot Ruffle Mini Dress ($28).

A New Day is the line for midis, up to the Faux Suede Drop Waist Midi Dress ($52). So expect to pay more than at Charlotte Russe for most pieces, but you can try them on in a store.

Where Target wins is returns. Most items get 90 days, and Target's own brands get up to a year with a receipt. That's the longest window on this list, which helps when you're buying in a hurry and aren't sure.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with budget. Windsor and AMIClubwear have full-price dresses starting near Charlotte Russe's $10, and rue21 sells the same label in store. Forever 21 and Missguided get close once you count their markdowns. If XL is your problem, Boohoo goes to a US 26 and ModCloth to 4X, with PrettyLittleThing best for petite and tall. For a dance or a formal, Windsor and Lucy in the Sky are built around events, and Windsor has stores. And if returns worry you, Target's 90 days and American Eagle's 60 are the most forgiving here.

faqs.q: Is Charlotte Russe still in business?
faqs.a: Yes. It went bankrupt in 2019 and closed its stores, and YM Inc. bought the brand that April and reopened it. It now has around 190 US stores and ships online to the 48 contiguous states.
faqs.source_query: is charlotte russe still in business

faqs.a: YM Inc., a Toronto-based retailer that bought it in April 2019. YM also owns rue21 and Urban Planet.

Yes. Online orders can be returned by mail within 30 days of the order date for a refund, though you pay the postage, or taken back to a store. Swimwear, intimates, jewelry and 70% to 80% off clearance are final sale.

faqs.q: How much is Charlotte Russe shipping?
faqs.a: $7.95 on orders under $100, and free from $100. It ships only to the 48 contiguous states, so not to Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico or APO addresses.
